title: Docs Viewer Roadmap
content_html:
Docs Viewer Roadmap

  1. Scope Media Management - expose and extend provider-independent inventory and lifecycle understanding for media already owned by each scope

  2. Docs Viewer Core Refactor - extract an explicit core, make configuration and runtime dependencies composition-owned, and recompose the integrated application without changing product behavior

  3. Standalone Docs Viewer - package and release a self-contained external-local application as the first independent core consumer

  4. Share Sub-Scope Documents - share a configured sub-scope as a document corpus without recreating domain adapters or canonical-data apply paths

  5. Mermaid Authoring And Publication - make fenced Mermaid the preferred source for document-contained diagrams and materialize static light/dark variants for public readers

  6. Public Docs Viewer Mobile Experience - review and deliberately redesign public scope, index, navigation, and reading behaviour for actual mobile browsers

  7. Semantic Reference Authoring - improve semantic-reference authoring when a bounded need becomes important

  8. Dated Export Snapshots - retain small browseable snapshots outside Docs Viewer without creating an archive scope
